lines.zh: 我们八条挤成一把银色的刀。
lines.en: Eight of us press into a single silver blade.

lines.zh: 我的喙先碰到水，才轮到身体。
lines.en: My beak touches the water before my body does.

lines.zh: 洋流推着我们往北，谁也没意见。
lines.en: The current pushes us north and nobody objects.

lines.zh: 我贴着沙脊游，喙尖划出浅沟。
lines.en: I skim the sand ridge, beak scoring a shallow groove.

lines.zh: 队伍散了又合，像被人缝起来。
lines.en: The school scatters and reknits, stitched by unseen hands.

lines.zh: 前面那条拐弯，我也跟着拐。
lines.en: The one ahead turns, and I turn with it.

lines.zh: 我的尾摆得急，银鳞一闪一闪。
lines.en: My tail beats fast and my silver scales flash.

lines.zh: 深水在下面，我们贴着亮处走。
lines.en: Deep water waits below; we travel along the bright layer.

lines.zh: 有鱼掉队了，我回头等它。
lines.en: One falls behind and I circle back to wait.

lines.zh: 我总比同伴快上半尾的距离。
lines.en: I keep half a tail ahead of my companions.

lines.zh: 喙缝里还卡着上顿的碎壳。
lines.en: A fleck of shell is still stuck in my beak.

lines.zh: 这片海太开阔，我们走得很紧。
lines.en: This sea is too open, so we keep very close.

lines.zh: 我用喙敲了敲同伴的侧腹。
lines.en: I tap my beak against a companion's flank.

lines.zh: 潮水换向，整群一起偏了半度。
lines.en: The tide turns and the whole school leans half a degree.

lines.zh: 我侧身一闪，银光晃了同伴的眼。
lines.en: I flick sideways and my silver flash blinds my neighbor.

lines.zh: 喙尖碰了一下石头，队伍乱了。
lines.en: My beak knocks a stone and the school scatters.

lines.zh: 我悬在水里，喙对着光的方向。
lines.en: I hang in the water, beak pointed at the light.

lines.zh: 一群小虾路过，我没动。
lines.en: A shoal of shrimp passes and I do not move.

lines.zh: 骨头沉在下面，白得像贝壳。
lines.en: Bones settle below, white as shell.

lines.zh: 我张嘴滤了一口水，什么也没有。
lines.en: I open my beak, strain a mouthful, and get nothing.

lines.zh: 同伴在左边，右边是空的蓝。
lines.en: A companion is to my left; to my right, empty blue.

lines.zh: 我在听远处鲸歌里的低音。
lines.en: I listen for the low notes inside distant whale song.

lines.zh: 喙有点痒，我蹭了蹭珊瑚。
lines.en: My beak itches, so I rub it on coral.

lines.zh: 水面上的光碎成很多小块。
lines.en: The light overhead breaks into many small pieces.

lines.zh: 我数了数，我们只剩七条。
lines.en: I count us and find only seven left.

lines.zh: 这片海盐分刚好，我懒得动。
lines.en: This sea is just salty enough; I cannot be bothered.

lines.zh: 有东西在沙里动，我盯着看。
lines.en: Something stirs in the sand and I stare at it.

lines.zh: 我打了个小小的嗝，冒出一串泡。
lines.en: I burp a little and release a string of bubbles.

lines.zh: 我的鳃一张一合，像在数拍子。
lines.en: My gills open and close as if counting time.

lines.zh: 银色的同伴挡住了一半的视野。
lines.en: A silver companion blocks half of my view.

lines.zh: 你在岸上，比我们都高得多。
lines.en: You stand on the shore, much taller than any of us.

lines.zh: 我游到你影子落下的地方。
lines.en: I swim into the place where your shadow falls.

lines.zh: 你的倒影里有很多条鱼。
lines.en: Your reflection holds a great many fish.

lines.zh: 我的喙对着你的手指，没动。
lines.en: My beak points at your fingers, and stays still.

lines.zh: 你在看我们，我们也在看你。
lines.en: You watch us; we are watching you too.

lines.zh: 你手里有桶，我认得那种响。
lines.en: You hold a bucket, and I know that sound.

lines.zh: 我侧过身，让银鳞闪你一下。
lines.en: I turn sideways and flash my silver at you.

lines.zh: 你蹲下来，水里的光暗了。
lines.en: You crouch, and the light in the water dims.

lines.zh: 别伸手，我们八条会一起散。
lines.en: Do not reach in; all eight of us will scatter.

lines.zh: 我绕着你映在水里的脸转圈。
lines.en: I circle the face you cast upon the water.

lines.zh: 有东西打中了我的侧腹！
lines.en: Something struck my flank!

lines.zh: 我整条鱼弹开，鳞掉了几片。
lines.en: I bolt away, a few scales coming loose.

lines.zh: 疼，从鳃一直传到尾根。
lines.en: Pain runs from my gills down to my tail.

lines.zh: 同伴全散了，只剩我一个。
lines.en: The whole school scatters and leaves me alone.

lines.zh: 我钻到石头缝里，先躲一下。
lines.en: I wedge into a stone crack and hide a moment.

lines.zh: 挨了这一下，我认不出南北。
lines.en: After that hit I cannot tell north from south.

lines.zh: 水里有我的血，很淡。
lines.en: My blood is in the water, faint and thin.

lines.zh: 我还能游，只是游得难看。
lines.en: I can still swim, only badly.

lines.zh: 谁在打我？我看不见。
lines.en: Who is hitting me? I cannot see them.

lines.zh: 我喘得很急，鳃都张开了。
lines.en: I gulp fast, gills flared wide.

lines.zh: 那是不是碎贝壳？我靠近一点。
lines.en: Is that broken shell? I edge a little closer.

lines.zh: 你指间有点白，像骨粉。
lines.en: Something white sits between your fingers, like bone meal.

lines.zh: 同伴都不敢来，我先来。
lines.en: None of my companions dare; I will go first.

lines.zh: 我张嘴又闭上，喙碰出轻响。
lines.en: I open my beak, close it, and click softly.

lines.zh: 这味道腥，但是是吃的。
lines.en: It smells fishy, but it is food.

lines.zh: 我绕着你的手画了个圈。
lines.en: I trace one circle around your hand.

lines.zh: 为一口吃的，值得离开鱼群吗？
lines.en: Is one mouthful worth leaving the school?

lines.zh: 我往前挪了半个身位，就半个。
lines.en: I advance half a body length — only half.

lines.zh: 那东西在水里散开，更香了。
lines.en: It spreads through the water and smells stronger.

lines.zh: 我忍不住，喙已经伸出去了。
lines.en: I cannot help it; my beak is already reaching out.

lines.zh: 谁的尾鳍打到我脸上。
lines.en: Someone's tail fin just struck my face.

lines.zh: 我们撞成一团，银鳞乱飞。
lines.en: We knock into a knot and silver scales fly.

lines.zh: 你踩进浅水，撞散了整群。
lines.en: You step into the shallows and split the whole school.

lines.zh: 我撞上同伴，又装作没事。
lines.en: I bump a companion and pretend nothing happened.

lines.zh: 骨头硌了我一下，很硬。
lines.en: A bone jabs me; it is very hard.

lines.zh: 我的喙抵住你的小腿，然后退。
lines.en: My beak presses your shin, then pulls away.

lines.zh: 水被搅浑，我找不到队伍。
lines.en: The water muddies and I lose the school.

lines.zh: 谁在挤我？这里明明很宽。
lines.en: Who is shoving me? There is plenty of room.

lines.zh: 我被撞得转了个圈才稳住。
lines.en: I am spun in a full circle before I steady myself.

lines.zh: 撞一下不痛，丢脸倒是真的。
lines.en: It does not hurt, though the shame certainly does.

lines.zh: 我绕着它转，喙轻轻碰它的鳃。
lines.en: I circle it, beak brushing lightly at its gills.

lines.zh: 我们并排游，尾鳍同步摆动。
lines.en: We swim abreast, tail fins beating in time.

lines.zh: 它银得比我亮，我认了。
lines.en: It shines brighter silver than I do; I accept that.

lines.zh: 产卵的地方要浅，还要有石缝。
lines.en: The spawning ground must be shallow, with cracks in stone.

lines.zh: 我把最亮的鳞侧给它看。
lines.en: I turn my brightest scales toward it.

lines.zh: 别的鱼挤过来，我挡住了。
lines.en: Other fish crowd in, and I block them off.

lines.zh: 我们绕着那块珊瑚礁兜圈子。
lines.en: We loop around that coral outcrop again and again.

lines.zh: 它的喙比我的短一点，很好看。
lines.en: Its beak is a little shorter than mine; it suits it.

lines.zh: 这一群以后会多出很多条。
lines.en: This school will hold many more before long.

lines.zh: 水里有细小的东西浮起来，是我们的。
lines.en: Tiny things rise in the water, and they are ours.

lines.zh: 我叼住骨粉，喙里全是粉。
lines.en: I snap up bone meal and my beak fills with dust.

lines.zh: 这块白东西我能含很久。
lines.en: I can hold this white thing for a long while.

lines.zh: 我用喙把它翻过来看了看。
lines.en: I flip it over with my beak and inspect it.

lines.zh: 同伴围上来，我游开了。
lines.en: My companions crowd close, so I swim off.

lines.zh: 它沉不下去，我只好一直咬着。
lines.en: It will not sink, so I simply keep biting it.

lines.zh: 嘴里有东西，游起来歪歪的。
lines.en: With something in my beak, I swim a little crooked.

lines.zh: 这是吃的，还是只是好看的？
lines.en: Is this food, or only something pretty?

lines.zh: 我试着吞，喙太窄，卡住了。
lines.en: I try to swallow; my beak is too narrow and jams.

lines.zh: 我把它藏进石缝，记住了位置。
lines.en: I tuck it into a stone crack and remember the spot.

lines.zh: 谁也别想从我嘴里抢走。
lines.en: Nobody is taking this out of my beak.

lines.zh: 水里有血味，很淡，但我闻到了。
lines.en: There is blood in the water, faint, but I smell it.

lines.zh: 那个影子比虾大，比我们小。
lines.en: That shadow is bigger than shrimp, smaller than us.

lines.zh: 我先转过去，同伴才跟上。
lines.en: I turn first, and my companions follow after.

lines.zh: 我把喙对准了那个动的方向。
lines.en: I aim my beak at whatever is moving there.

lines.zh: 是食物，还是一场麻烦？
lines.en: Is that supper, or a great deal of trouble?

lines.zh: 整群忽然安静，都在看同一个点。
lines.en: The school goes quiet, all watching the same point.

lines.zh: 我压低身体，贴着沙前进。
lines.en: I sink low and glide forward over the sand.

lines.zh: 有东西在水面扑腾，声音很清楚。
lines.en: Something flounders at the surface, quite audible.

lines.zh: 我离它还有三个身位。
lines.en: I am still three body lengths away from it.

lines.zh: 我张嘴试了试，只是空咬一口。
lines.en: I test my open beak with one empty snap.

lines.zh: 我锁住它，尾鳍几乎不动。
lines.en: I lock onto it, tail fin nearly still.

lines.zh: 同伴让开一条路，我游过去。
lines.en: My companions part a lane, and I swim through.

lines.zh: 它没看见我们，还在翻沙。
lines.en: It has not seen us and keeps turning the sand.

lines.zh: 我数着距离，两身位，一身位。
lines.en: I count the distance: two lengths, then one.

lines.zh: 水在我鳃边变凉，是它搅的。
lines.en: The water cools at my gills; it churned that.

lines.zh: 别急，喙要等它转身。
lines.en: Wait; my beak must wait until it turns.

lines.zh: 我听见自己的心跳，快得像尾摆。
lines.en: I hear my own heart, as fast as my tail.

lines.zh: 它动了，我跟着偏了半寸。
lines.en: It moves, and I lean half an inch with it.

lines.zh: 整群散开，把它围在中间。
lines.en: The school spreads and rings it in the middle.

lines.zh: 这一口下去，够我们分吗？
lines.en: Will one bite of this be enough to share?

lines.zh: 我用喙啄它，一下比一下狠。
lines.en: I peck at it, each strike harder than the last.

lines.zh: 喙尖碰到软的，我咬住不放。
lines.en: My beak finds something soft, and I hold on.

lines.zh: 它甩尾打我，我被拍偏了。
lines.en: Its tail slaps me and I am knocked aside.

lines.zh: 我们八条一起上，它顾不过来。
lines.en: All eight of us strike at once; it cannot keep up.

lines.zh: 我啄出一小口，血散在水里。
lines.en: I tear a small bite and blood clouds the water.

lines.zh: 喙根有点疼，我还是继续。
lines.en: The base of my beak aches; I keep going anyway.

lines.zh: 它在挣扎，水全被搅白了。
lines.en: It thrashes and the water turns white with silt.

lines.zh: 我退开半步，让同伴补上。
lines.en: I pull back half a step and let a companion take over.

lines.zh: 这一下啄空了，我撞到石头。
lines.en: This peck misses and I knock into stone.

lines.zh: 它不动了，我们还在啄。
lines.en: It has stopped moving, and we are still pecking.

lines.zh: 我在陌生的海里睁开眼，四周很蓝。
lines.en: I open my eyes in a strange sea, blue on all sides.

lines.zh: 潮水把我推进浅滩，我就留下了。
lines.en: The tide shoves me into the shallows, and I stay.

lines.zh: 这里没有同伴，我先自己游一圈。
lines.en: No companions here; I take a lap on my own.

lines.zh: 沙是新的，珊瑚也是新的。
lines.en: The sand is new, and so is the coral.

lines.zh: 我张了张嘴，尝出这片海的味道。
lines.en: I open my beak and taste what this sea is like.

lines.zh: 这条命是别人放进水里的。
lines.en: This life was placed into the water by someone else.

lines.zh: 我还没找到队伍，先跟着洋流走。
lines.en: I have not found a school, so I follow the current.

lines.zh: 头顶有光，我就往那边去。
lines.en: There is light overhead, so I head toward it.

lines.zh: 骨头和肉，我以后都得自己找。
lines.en: Bone and flesh: from now on I find both myself.

lines.zh: 第一口咸水，我记住了。
lines.en: I remember the first mouthful of salt water.

lines.zh: 水是凉的，火怎么还烧到我？
lines.en: The water is cold; how is fire still burning me?

lines.zh: 我从水里被抛上去，又砸回来。
lines.en: I am thrown clear of the water, then slammed back.

lines.zh: 我本来就在水里，怎么会淹？
lines.en: I live in water; how am I drowning?

lines.zh: 水面炸开了，我被掀翻。
lines.en: The surface bursts and I am flipped over.

lines.zh: 箭穿过水面，钉进我的侧鳍。
lines.en: An arrow crosses the surface and pins my side fin.

lines.zh: 有什么东西绕过水，直接咬我的骨头。
lines.en: Something skips the water and bites my very bones.

lines.zh: 肚子里空得能看见形状。
lines.en: My belly is so empty I can feel its shape.

lines.zh: 闪电劈开海面，我鳞片全炸起来。
lines.en: Lightning splits the sea and every scale stands up.

lines.zh: 水底忽然没有了，我在往下掉。
lines.en: The seafloor vanishes and I am falling.
